content.title: BP to sell 65% of Castrol stake, Sanofi's $2.2B deal for Dynavax
content.description:
Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including BP (BP) selling 65% of its stake in Castrol automotive lubricant business to Stonepeak, Sanofi (SNY) agreeing to acquire hepatitis B vaccine maker Dynavax Technologies (DVAX) in a $2.2 billion deal, and UiPath (PATH) is scheduled to begin trading on the S&P Midcap 400 index (^SP400).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
